variant.changelog: Added independent Eidos lights with live editing, Undo, save/load and session cleanup. Pose files now apply directly from Files; Apply IK has its own visible row. Repaired camera-path seek, restart and camera restoration, and reset clone names each GPose session. Fixed closing the tool window; added compact header collapse through the chevron or double-clicking Eidos, and direct clone buttons in Actors. Retains the startup, cloning, viewport and performance repairs from previous testing builds.
